title: [observability] Core lines' human interventions per agent-hour is the Home card's, over its 24 h window, said beside it (A22, part 1 of 100/100b/102)
prompt:
Read crates/spawn-cli/src/serve/core_lines.rs (`lines_at`, where the observability line's inputs are read) and crates/spawn-cli/src/serve/core_lines/observability.rs (`Observed`, `observability_line`), and crates/spawn-cli/src/scorecard/interventions.rs (`window_of`, `measure`: the answer of `/api/interventions`).

The problem (cc-astra A22, HIGH; sync/astra/findings.md). Two figures named "human interventions per agent-hour" disagree, and not by window: the Home card (`/api/interventions?window=24h`) counts what the owner had to do (a person's commands, mission resumes, tasks a person assigned, cancel-and-reassign), while Core lines' guardrail `observability.interventions_per_agent_hour` reads /api/fleet's `health.human_per_agent_hour`, which counts a person's commands only. A resume or a task the owner assigned moves the Home card and not Core lines, under the same name and the same range, so Core lines can understate human work against the guardrail.

Required behaviour. Core lines takes the Home card's definition. This is part of A22's fix, not all of it: 100b brings the Fleet page's `health.human_per_agent_hour` to the same count and 102 counts a pause as an intervention; A22 counts as fixed only when 100 and 100b have both landed.
- Core lines' `observability.interventions_per_agent_hour` is `/api/interventions?window=24h`'s `per_agent_hour` (the same items, the same agent time, the 24 h window ending at the reading's now), null when that is null. Read it through the scorecard's interventions answer (`window_of`, `measure`), not a second count.
- The figure says its window: in /api/core-lines it carries `"window": "24h"` (no other figure carries a window), and the Core lines card (web/src/coreLines.ts) shows it beside the name: "Human interventions per agent-hour (last 24 h)".
- Nothing else changes here: /api/fleet's `health.human_per_agent_hour` is 100b's, and every other figure of /api/core-lines is unchanged.

Files (expected; no other open objective touches them): crates/spawn-cli/src/serve/core_lines.rs, crates/spawn-cli/src/serve/core_lines/observability.rs, web/src/coreLines.ts. Keep the change small (well under 150 lines); update the doc comments that say health's human_per_agent_hour.

Acceptance: rsi/scenarios/100.sh. It seeds 8 agent-hours, a mission resumed and a task a person assigned in the last day (no command in it) and a person's command 30 h ago, and reads /api/interventions (24h and 7d) and /api/core-lines: Core lines' figure must be the card's 24 h per_agent_hour, 0.25, with window "24h", and coreLinesView must name it "Human interventions per agent-hour (last 24 h)". The older scenarios that read the observability line (084, 088, 089, 090, 092) must still pass.
